gaps.sentence: His attitude ___ work has really improved.
I'm going to apply ___ that job in Rotterdam.
gaps.explanation: apply FOR a job; apply TO a company/university.

gaps.sentence: They accused him ___ lying to the committee.
He boasted ___ winning the race, but nobody believed him.
gaps.explanation: boast ABOUT/OF something. 'About' is the most common.

gaps.sentence: Bamboo is a classic example ___ fast-growing plant.
The only reason ___ the delay was the storm.
Fast charging is a big advantage ___ this model.

gaps.explanation: shout AT somebody = be aggressive; shout TO = call so they hear.
